How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Happy to share the key steps for getting the best result!



Measure carefully — use a metal tape measure, measure at three points (top, middle, bottom) for width, and use the smallest measurement. For height, measure left, middle, and right the same way.


Choose recess vs. exact fit — recess fitting sits inside the window frame and we make small deductions for a perfect fit; exact fitting is for outside the recess or if you want no deductions.


Installation — each blind comes with its own fitting instructions, and most only need a drill, screws, and a few minutes. Some ranges even have no-drill options.


Daily use — raise and lower with the control chain gently, avoiding tugging the fabric itself.



Please note: Twist2Go and Click2Go No Drill blinds are only suitable for recess fitting and cannot be fitted outside the recess. If you're ordering one of these, measure at the top of the recess where the blind will be fitted, and we'll make the necessary deductions.
